messages:
Priya: Quick weekly check-in for Meridian onboarding  saw a concentrated 5xx + timeout spike this morning. Posting summary and top endpoints.
Jamal: on it, paste the metrics pls
Priya: Window 02:00-05:00 UTC:
- overall error rate: 3.2% (norm ~0.5%)
- 5xx: 2.1% (502/503 dominant)
- gateway timeouts: 0.8%
- 429s: 0.3%
Priya: Top failing endpoints by count:
1) POST /v1/generate (41%)
2) POST /v1/embeddings (17%)
3) POST /v1/chat/stream (13%)
4) GET /v1/model/status (9%)
5) POST /v1/session/kv-sync (5%)
Priya: Trace snippets:
[2026-03-25T02:11:02Z] req=x1 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=runtime-io msg="upstream reset"
[2026-03-25T02:11:06Z] req=x2 route=/v1/generate latency=3.8s gateway_timeout=true
[2026-03-25T02:12:44Z] req=y1 route=/v1/embeddings status=429 key_qps=58
Elsa: Any rollout notes? @infra-bot
infra-bot: deploy-bot: prod rollout r-2026-03-25-0130 completed at 2026-03-25T01:30:12Z. Variants: runtime-v2.4, batching-svc-v1.9. No automatic rollback.
Jamal: rollout time aligns. Hypothesis: runtime-v2.4 kernel regression under heavier seq-lengths. I'll check host EPIPE and batch connection errors.
Tomas: Meridian is in ramp; this could affect their demo flows. Priya, prep a short CSM note offering mitigation steps.
Priya: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- route Meridian POST /v1/generate to runtime-v2.3 canary (10%) then ramp if stable
- increase internal batching timeout 3s->6s for affected routes
- short-term per-key throttle for keys with high concurrency (cap 45 qps)
Elsa: I'll enable verbose logs on affected hosts and flip 10% canary now.
Jamal: I'll provision extra runtime-v2.3 nodes and prepare rollback playbook. Also checking KV cache eviction rates (might explain gateway timeouts).
Priya: Action items:
- Jamal: scale + canary (ETA 15m)
- Elsa: logs + canary (ETA 10m)
- Priya: CSM note + weekly doc update (ETA 12m)
- Tomas: prepare renewal ops note if asked (standby)
infra-bot: alert-summary: 85% of 502s from two hosts in us-west-2 (i-0d1e2f3a, i-0d1e2f3b). Leads: Jamal, Elsa.
Priya: Will update in 30m with verification metrics. If stable we'll keep routing changes and document in weekly account health.
Jamal: remediation started, posting logs as they come.
